# Generation source provenance

The participant traffic adapter, constrained sampler, native renderer adapters and shared GenBench loader are from the two-scene Participant Visual Demos snapshot dated 2026-11-23. Native projects retain their own licenses. The tracked models/generation tree supplies native model backbones and their source dependencies. The offline installer reuses separately installed environment packages, compatible compiled extensions, token vocabularies and checkpoints.

The CAT-K entry reads its official model source and weights from the configured native runtime directory. It verifies the migrated official Python source inventory and checkpoint and vocabulary checksums. The MagicDrive-V2 geometry helper contains the native functions used in the participant path. MagicDrive-V2 accepts the complete participant case-ID format and explicit input/output paths. The HorizonDrive config takes its data root from the launcher environment. The source snapshot kept here contains inference integration code and configuration.

The offline source distribution includes release-specific source and preserved license notices for CAT-K, MagicDrive-V2, DriveAudit/BaseDreamer, DreamForge, MagicDrive, OpenDWM, HorizonDrive, Panacea and their bundled library components. The developer's native OpenDWM training/demo dataset defaults and model paths were removed from the packed inference configuration. DriveAudit supplies participant scenes and explicit checkpoint paths at launch. The CAT-K source retains NVIDIA's research/evaluation license and the original SMART notices. The top-level MagicDrive-V2 and its rd code retain their respective licenses. See the complete inventory in `bundles/native-sources.tar.json`.
